parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description:
The list of task statuses. Valid values:
- Pending: The refresh task is created and waiting to be executed.
- InProgress: The refresh task is being processed.
- Success: The refresh task is executed.
- Failed: The refresh task failed.
